department: Faculty of Engineering — Department of Mechanical Engineering

deadline.value: Main Round and Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) deadline for 2027-28 entry is December 1, 2026 (1st Clearing Round: April 30, 2027; 2nd Clearing Round: August 31, 2027).
deadline.quote: September 1, 2026 - December 1, 2026 (HKT 23:59 or GMT +8 hours) | The submission deadline for HKPFS applications in 2027-28 is December 1, 2026.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for mechanical engineering (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Faculty of Engineering instructs MPhil/PhD applicants to search for potential supervisors and discuss proposed research areas before submitting an application.
supervisor.quote: Search for potential supervisor(s) (contact details and brief introduction of teaching staff are also available in the departmental websites). | Discuss the proposed research areas with the potential supervisor(s) before submitting application.

funding.value: Full-time PhD candidates may hold a University Postgraduate Scholarship (HK$19,135/month; HK$19,655/month after confirmation, wef 1/9/2026) or other fellowship (HKU-PS, HKPF), subject to funding availability.
funding.quote: Full-time candidates may hold a University postgraduate studentship or another postgraduate studentship or scholarship which is intended to enable them to study on a full-time basis.

also.quote: The basic level of scholarship is HK$19,135 per month (wef 1/9/2026).

entry_route.value: Candidates without a research master's degree are considered for the 4-year PhD; those holding a research master's degree are considered for the 3-year PhD.
entry_route.quote: Candidates without a research Master’s degree will be considered for admission to a 4-year PhD program, and those who hold research Master’s degrees will be considered for admission to a 3-year PhD program.

notes: Covers Design and Manufacture, Materials and Solids, Natural and Built Environment, Sound, Vibration and Control, Thermofluids, and Biomedical Engineering.
